description: This file defines the LocationSync class, which implements plugin, web, and JSON-RPC interfaces for location synchronization in the WPEFramework plugin system. It includes nested classes for data handling, notifications, and configuration, and declares methods for initialization, deinitialization, location updates, and event handling.

classes.name: LocationSync
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing location synchronization, web interface, and JSON-RPC communication.

classes.name: LocationSync::Data
classes.description: JSON container for location data including IP, timezone, region, country, and city.

classes.name: LocationSync::Notification
classes.description: Handles location-related notifications, manages location service probing, and dispatches location updates.

classes.name: LocationSync::Config
classes.description: Configuration container for sync interval, retries, and source URL.

methods.name: LocationSync::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given service.

methods.name: LocationSync::Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and generates responses.
